segment: The three review items are done: the injection snapshot no longer walks the whole DSH area, the reply-text check runs against its own store, and the tester set is one agreed, reproducible whole

1_injection_snapshot_scope.the_defect: _write_injection_snapshot() derived its read scope from Path(directory).parent.parent.rglob('*'), which for a result directory inside /home/jericho/.dsh/tmp was the whole of /home/jericho/.dsh: every session, every neighbouring bench and every cache, each file read in full.
1_injection_snapshot_scope.the_repair: the set of files is named explicitly by the request (inject_snapshot_files) and the scope of the read is never derived from a directory's parents. Every named file must exist, be a regular file, not be a symlink and stay inside the home; the digest is computed by streaming with a 64 KiB buffer and a 64 MiB bound. A missing file, an unreadable file, a symlink, a path outside the home and an empty file set are explicit refusals, never silent skips.
1_injection_snapshot_scope.the_boundary_fixture: check-snapshot-boundary.py builds a tiny fixture: two named bench files, a foreign DSH session file and a foreign neighbouring-bench file. The two foreign files are made UNREADABLE (mode 000), so any read of them would fail loudly. The check proves that only the named files are read, that the foreign files are absent from the read set, and that a missing file, a symlink, a path outside the home and an empty set each give their own explicit Refused.
1_injection_snapshot_scope.the_working_home: not published, not rolled back; the change is in the diagnostic branch

2_reply_text_contract_isolation.the_defect: the check built bt.Runner(bt.Store(bt.CANONICAL_STATE), None), so the product's own keep_text() wrote four synthetic receipts into the working downloads directory.
2_reply_text_contract_isolation.the_repair: the check now uses its own small Store inside /home/jericho/.dsh/tmp/reply-text-contract-check. The writer and the reader under test are the product's own methods; only the storage is replaced. The working CANONICAL_STATE is never created, opened or changed.

the_synthetic_receipts.identified: unambiguously this check's own output: every one of them carries run_id contract-fixture, message_id 4242 and the exact wording of this check's fixtures
the_synthetic_receipts.quarantine: /home/jericho/.local/share/friday-telegram-bot-test/quarantine/contract-fixture-text-receipts/ with QUARANTINE.json recording every path, size and digest
the_synthetic_receipts.not_touched: no real run, capture, cursor or historical receipt was changed; the downloads directory still holds its other 376 files

the_fixtures: an ordinary text reply: written with the product's keep_text(), the SAVED bytes on disk are read back and accepted by the common reader

a document reply that really carries a 'document' field and a caption and no text field: the saved caption is recorded as the wording with text_source 'caption', the receipt kind stays reply_text, the document does NOT become an accepted artifact and max_documents stays 0

an old receipt without the source marker: taken from the SAVED bytes of such a receipt on disk, not by deleting a field from a new dictionary; it still confirms message.text, and the same old receipt against a reply without the text field is refused
a substituted caption, a substituted source and an unknown source: each gives the expected Refused reason, and a foreign exception is not counted as a successful negative test
2_reply_text_contract_isolation.the_distinction: the check exercises the product's writer and the common reader method. The full chain of a saved receipt through the whole custody check of a run is proved separately by the inspect of the live runs, not by this fixture set.
2_reply_text_contract_isolation.the_historical_M03_branch: not used as evidence for the common repair
